review_notes: Decode a local time with fractional seconds. Hour/minute components are swapped and fraction digits are padded on the wrong side with the wrong value. Preserve localtime field order and right-zero-pad fractional seconds to microseconds. Original F2P/P2P unchanged. Baseline diagnostic failure is expected task reproduction, not a policy error. Source imports asserted against the workspace before and after the repair.

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'PYREPLAY'
from pathlib import Path
import hashlib, importlib
expected=(Path.cwd() / 'src/tomli/_re.py').resolve()
try:
 module = importlib.import_module('tomli._re')
except Exception as import_error:
 traceback=import_error.__traceback__
 while traceback is not None:
  file=traceback.tb_frame.f_globals.get('__file__')
  if file and Path(file).resolve()==expected:
   print('source_binding', str(expected), 'sha256', hashlib.sha256(expected.read_bytes()).hexdigest(), 'actual_import_failure_frame')
  traceback=traceback.tb_next
 raise
actual=Path(module.__file__).resolve()
print("source_binding", str(actual), "sha256", hashlib.sha256(actual.read_bytes()).hexdigest())
assert actual == expected, (actual, expected)
import tomli
from datetime import time
value=tomli.loads('t=13:04:05.12')['t'];print('decoded_localtime',value)
assert value==time(13,4,5,120000)
